notes: The best specification of any out-of-stock row: USD 1.00 a month on annual prepay for 1 GB RAM, 15 GB NVMe, 2 TB of traffic, a 1 Gbps port, 20 forwarded records and a dedicated /112, on Hetzner infrastructure in Germany. It is also the only seller whose store states the protocol of the forwarded ports in words: the KVM group says '20 Ports (TCP/UDP)', which is the UDP answer every other row leaves as a dash. And it is the second seller, after Axivora, to name a legal entity: PT Media Creative Technology, in the site footer. None of that makes it buyable. Every NAT group read today refuses at the cart: the Indonesia group reads '0 Available' on all three plans, the KVM group reads '0 Available' on all three, the Singapore group reads '0 Available' and has no IPv6 at all, and the Hetzner group carries no stock marker on its page while its cart returns 'Out of Stock ... orders for it have been suspended'. The Hetzner case is the third instance of a listing that looks orderable and a cart that refuses, so the cart's word is recorded over the page's. What is not established: whether any group restocks, the payment rails, and whether PT Media Creative Technology is registered, since the Indonesian AHU registry was not queried. A restock check is the only thing worth re-running.
